answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 1330 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: If some one performes Aqeeqah per year is it against sunnah or not? What right way for this Sunnah? Question: If some one performes Aqeeqah per year is it against sunnah or not? What right way for this Sunnah? Answer ID: 1330 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 850/850=J) Aqeeqah is sunnah on the seventh day of birth. If it is not performed on seventh day it will cease to be mustahab . If aqeeqah is performed after seventh day then it will turn nafl i.e. this will also deserve reward but now as much as mustahab. Therefore, one can perform aqeeqah after a year also, but it is better to take consideration of seventh day e.g. the child was born on Friday then the aqeeqah should be performed on Thursday. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
